title: Trip to IHOP
author: Danner Claflin
problems: Row 4 "facing star clockwise 3 places with robins putting their left hands in and backing up" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
The progression after row 7 "star left 4 places" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).

figures.text: robins to the center to a long wavy line, balance, and stay there
larks to the center to a long wavy line, balance, and stay there, larks let go left, robins let go right
